scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n firebase,vite -c yellow,magenta "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-impostor "npm test -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,database,auth
